sourceBookName: 晨读美文 适用于5-6年级
name: Day 1 Hello, hello, hello

article.html:
Hello, hello, hello. Hi, hi, hi.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

It’s a nice day, let’s whistle a tune.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

It’s wonderful night, let’s dance in the moonlight.

name: Day 2 The moon

article.html:
The moon is light.

The moon is gold.

The moon is like a boat.

I want to sit in it.

The moon is like a banana.

I want to eat it.

The moon is like Mom’s smile.

I want to kiss her.

name: Day 3 What Does Little Birdie say?

article.html:
What does little birdie say?

In her nest at peep of day.

Let me fly, says little birdie.

Mother, let me fly away.

Birdie, rest a little longer.

Till the little wings are stronger.

So she rests a little longer.

Then she flies away.

Falling down, falling down.

London bridge is falling down, my fair lady.

Build it up with iron bars.

Iron bars, iron bars.

I can sing a rainbow.

Sing a rainbow, sing a rainbow.

Listen with your ears and sing everything you see.

Slowly, slowly, very slowly,

up the wooden rail.

Quickly, quickly, very quickly,

runs the little mouse.

Quickly, quickly, very quickly,

Mary Middling had a pig.

Not very little and not very big.

Not very pink, not very green.

Not very dirty, not very clean.

Not very good, not very naughty.

Not very humble, not very haughty.

Not very thin, not very fat.

Now what would you give for a pig like that?

Here is my handle.

Here is my spout.

When I get all steamed up,

hear me shout.

Tip me over and pour me out.

article.html:
There is a sweet maiden asleep by the sea.

Her lips are as red as a cherry.

The roses are resting upon her brown cheeks.

Her cheeks are brown as a berry.

She’s tired of building up castles of sand.

Softly I will sing you a lullaby song.

And soon you will slumber most sweetly.

How happy the children are!

Draw little birds flying in the blue sky.

Draw little grass growing in spring.

I draw the sun, and you draw the motherland.

Motherland, motherland, we love you.

Swim, swim, swim at the pool,

swim like a little fish.

Run, run, keep the pace,

as fast as you can.

Jump, jump, jump over the bar,

as high as you can.

Play, play, play soccer,

with your friends.

Let’s do sports together!

name: Day 13 Christmas

article.html:
I’m dreaming of a white Christmas,

The treetops glisten, and children listen,

to hear sleigh bells in the snow.

I’m dreaming of the white Christmas,

with every Christmas card I write.

May your days be merry and bright,

and may all your Christmases be white.

The first one said, “The pool is cool.”

The second one said, “The pool is deep.”

The third one said, “I want to sleep.”

The fourth one said, “Let’s dive and dip.”

The fifth one said, “I spy a ship.”

The fisherman’s boat comes,

The line goes ker-splash,

And away the five little fishes dash.

He caught the mosquito.

He caught the flea.

name: Day 17 Twelve Months

article.html:

February brings cold winds.

March brings rain.

April brings pretty flowers.

May brings green trees.

June brings Children’s Day.

July brings summer holiday.

August and September bring golden grain.

October brings leaves to the earth.

November and December become cold.

A year will pass.

my cousins.

Sophie: Me, too.

guess who they are?

brother.

Joe: Wow, you have a happy family.

Mom: Good job! Always remember to share with

others.

article.html:
The earthquake is one of the most severe natural disasters. So it’s important to know how to stay safe on earthquake.

If you are inside, hide under a strong table. This protects you from falling objects. If you are outside, move to an open area. Stay away from buildings and trees, as they can fall during an earthquake. Always have an emergency kit at home. It should include water, food, and a first aid kit. After the shaking stops, check for safe exits.

Earthquakes are powerful, but being prepared helps us stay safe.
